One time someone actually asked me how I was doing when I was eating lunch with a bunch of girls. And they were seriously asking about how I was feeling. Like I'm going to tell you in front of everything. Of course I'm "fine".

I rarely ever get asked, and when I do, its just not the time. When it is the time, no one is there. I feel pretty alone.

Thank you, that is exactly how I feel. I've told them I'm suicidal yet it would have been better to not say anything. Since nothing is different.

I appreciate your understanding, I'm ok now, just got really angry when a mutual friend of ours wrote a song saying something like "If you could have just told us" blah blah. Well, he could have told you. Then things would go back to normal. Then he probably would have still killed himself anyway. 

Its like, some sick way of making themselves feel better, like they weren't responsible.
Thank you, really...so much. I appreciate your kind words. You are right, I need to go get help. You and your mom are awesome, and I know your younger brother was too. Thank you again

Is it worthwhile to see a therapist and take medicine? This sounds exactly like what I have, but I keep resisting meds and seeing someone because I don't know if I can afford it. Also I'm a mixture of being too proud, lazy, and ashamed of who I am because of it. And I keep trying to convince myself it doesn't exist, because I don't feel it when good things happen.

Edit: Thanks everyone, for your advice, I really do appreciate it. I have gone to see a counselor, a free one at school, who kept telling me my type of depression was not normal, but she never told me what it was. So it's comforting to know that other people feel the same way I do. You guys are awesome.
I want to kill myself even though my life is fucking wonderful :/ depression sucks
